# Support

- **How do I use Paneflo?** Start with the [user guide](../docs/user-guide.md) and the [shortcuts list](../docs/shortcuts.md).
- **Something doesn't work?** Check [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md) (permissions, gestures, previews, updates), then [open an issue](https://github.com/Jenish-Shobhit/Paneflo/issues/new/choose). Include your macOS version, the Paneflo version (menu bar icon > About Paneflo), the steps, and the output of `/Applications/Paneflo.app/Contents/MacOS/Paneflo --diagnostics` for startup or permission problems. Don't paste real window titles or private screenshots.
- **Feature ideas:** open a feature request issue.
- **Security problems:** use a [private advisory](https://github.com/Jenish-Shobhit/Paneflo/security/advisories/new), see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
